text: {"assertions":["A 401 authentication storm in services/auth/token_refresh.py was caused by a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The fix for the 401 storm involved removing the listener on teardown and adding a test assertion in tests/auth/test_token_refresh.py.","The 401 storm fix was submitted in PR #5226 on branch fix/401-storm-1.","The 401 storm could be reproduced by allowing an access token to expire mid-session.","The 401 storm manifested as a burst of unauthorized responses in the access log.","After the fix was applied, the alert remained quiet for 73 consecutive days without incident."]}
